title: When Benchmarks Leak: Inference-Time Decontamination for LLMs
authors_zh: Chai Jianzhe, Yu Zhe, Jun Sakuma
paper_type_zh: 推理时基准去污染与评测可靠性研究
best_for_zh: 需要在保留原始基准的前提下审计泄露分数与干净效用的研究者。
one_line: DeconIEP suppresses memorization-driven behavior at evaluation time with bounded embedding perturbations.
以参考模型引导的有界嵌入扰动，在不改题目或参数的前提下抑制污染捷径。
why: It separates a contaminated model’s shortcut behavior from clean-input utility without deleting benchmark items.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 addition: its central contribution audits contamination, verifier reliability, or judge bias with an explicit evaluation object.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Leaked benchmark items can make an LLM appear capable because it retrieves training exposure rather than generalizing. Removing suspected items with membership inference changes the benchmark and leaves residual leakage whenever the detector has false negatives; applying one broad inference intervention can also damage clean inputs.

The paper instead keeps each prompt and benchmark item fixed, and treats decontamination as an inference-time correction. It studies whether a contaminated fine-tuned model can be steered toward the behavior of a less-contaminated reference while retaining utility on an unrelated clean benchmark. The intended comparison is therefore between corrected contaminated behavior and an explicit clean counterfactual, rather than between two headline benchmark scores.

基准题目一旦泄露，LLM 可能依靠训练暴露检索答案而非真正泛化，从而显得能力更强。用成员推断筛掉疑似题目会改变基准；只要检测器存在假阴性，残留泄露仍会抬高分数。对所有输入施加同一种推理干预，又可能伤害干净题目。

论文保持提示词和基准题目不变，把去污染视为推理时校正。它检验：能否让受污染微调模型的行为靠近污染较轻的参考模型，同时在无关的干净基准上保留效用。因此，目标比较的是校正后的污染行为与明确的干净反事实，而不是两个表面基准分数之间的高低。这样可将污染造成的虚高与真实任务能力的变化分开讨论。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DeconIEP learns an instance-adaptive, bounded perturbation in input-embedding space. A lightweight generator uses the embedding of each item to produce a perturbation, then drives the contaminated model's output distribution toward that of a same-architecture reference model that is relatively less contaminated. The discrete prompt and model parameters remain unchanged; the ℓ∞ budget constrains the intervention. This targets memorization-driven shortcut pathways without filtering benchmark items or relying on a perfectly clean reference. The official ACL page exposes the paper only: no official code or standalone dataset release is linked. The method is a mitigation layer for a specified evaluation setting, so its output should be read alongside the reference choice, perturbation budget, and clean-utility test.

DeconIEP 在输入嵌入空间学习按样本自适应且有界的扰动。轻量生成器根据每个题目的嵌入产生扰动，使受污染模型的输出分布靠近同架构、污染相对较轻的参考模型。离散提示词与模型参数均不改变，ℓ∞ 预算约束干预幅度。它试图削弱记忆化捷径，而不筛除基准题目，也不要求参考模型绝对干净。官方 ACL 页面只提供论文，未链接官方代码或独立数据集发布。该方法是针对特定评测设置的缓解层，其输出必须连同参考模型选择、扰动预算和干净效用测试一起解读，不能脱离这些条件宣称分数已经代表真实泛化。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Start from a pretrained model, construct a contaminated fine-tuned model with OpenOrca plus leaked MMLU or TruthfulQA items, and train a matched clean counterpart on OpenOrca only.
  2. Choose the same-architecture pretrained checkpoint as the relatively less-contaminated reference, and reserve 400 benchmark samples disjoint from each test set as Daux.
  3. Feed an item's embedding to a four-layer decoder-only generator and bound its output as δ=ζ·tanh(Gθ(e(x))).
  4. Optimize KL plus cross-entropy so the contaminated model run on e(x)+δ follows the reference distribution and hard labels.
  5. Apply one perturbation per unchanged test input; report Residual Contamination and Benign Utility Drop. The reported setup uses ζ=10⁻³, learning rate 10⁻⁵, dropout 0.2, and white-box embeddings/gradients. The construction makes the clean counterpart observable only in controlled experiments; in a real audit it is an ideal target that must be approximated by the chosen reference.

1. 从预训练模型出发，用 OpenOrca 加泄露的 MMLU 或 TruthfulQA 题目构造受污染微调模型，并仅用 OpenOrca 训练样本数相同的干净对照。
  2. 选择同架构预训练检查点作为污染较轻的参考，并从基准中留出与测试集不相交的 400 个样本构成 Daux。
  3. 将题目嵌入送入四层 decoder-only 生成器，并用 δ=ζ·tanh(Gθ(e(x))) 约束输出。
  4. 以 KL 加交叉熵优化，使受污染模型在 e(x)+δ 上贴近参考分布与硬标签。
  5. 每个未改动测试输入只施加一次扰动，报告残余污染与良性效用下降。设置为 ζ=10⁻³、学习率 10⁻⁵、dropout 0.2，且需要白盒嵌入与梯度。这种构造只在受控实验中使干净对照可观测；真实审计里它是需要由所选参考模型近似的理想目标，因而参考选择与辅助样本划分都会影响最终解释。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The key claim is that targeted embedding perturbation reduces contamination inflation with less clean-task damage than competing white-box interventions. The controlled setup fine-tunes Mistral, Qwen2.5, and LLaMA-3 with exact, semantic-level, or domain-level leakage from MMLU or TruthfulQA, then evaluates the contaminated and clean counterparts under occurrence o=3. In Table 2, DeconIEP obtains low residual contamination across the three families; for example, its Mistral MMLU exact-leakage residual is 0.007. In Table 3 its benign utility drop for Qwen2.5 is 0.009 on TruthfulQA and 0.029 on MMLU, versus 0.207 and 0.256 for Shortcut Neuron. The evidence is simulated leakage on listed models and benchmarks, not proof for unknown real training corpora. The clean benchmark is deliberately different from the leaked one, so the utility measure tests collateral interference rather than a second measurement of the same contamination.

核心主张是：定向嵌入扰动可降低污染带来的分数膨胀，并比其他白盒干预更少伤害干净任务。受控设置在 Mistral、Qwen2.5 和 LLaMA-3 上，从 MMLU 或 TruthfulQA 注入精确、语义级或领域级泄露，在出现次数 o=3 下比较污染模型与干净对照。表 2 中，DeconIEP 在三类模型上取得较低残余污染；例如 Mistral 的 MMLU 精确泄露残余为 0.007。表 3 中，Qwen2.5 的良性效用下降在 TruthfulQA 和 MMLU 分别为 0.009、0.029，而 Shortcut Neuron 为 0.207、0.256。证据限于列出的模型、基准和模拟泄露，不能证明未知真实训练语料同样有效。干净基准被刻意设为与泄露基准不同，因此效用指标测量的是附带干扰，而不是对同一污染的第二次计分。该设计有助于区分去污染效果与模型能力普遍下降。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Detect-then-filter methods change the evaluated set and are limited by detection error; earlier black-box approaches calibrate outputs or rewrite prompts, while white-box approaches edit activations or bypass attention. DeconIEP instead learns a per-instance perturbation at the input embedding, leaving text, weights, and benchmark membership unchanged. Its reference-guided KL objective turns a relatively less-contaminated checkpoint into a behavioral anchor, rather than locating a fixed set of shortcut neurons. The novelty is a controllable inference-time mechanism for the residual-contamination versus clean-utility trade-off, not a method for proving data provenance or removing training exposure. The bounded budget also exposes a measurable control variable: stronger perturbation can lower residual contamination but raises benign utility loss, so the method reports a trade-off rather than a single unrestricted correction.

先检测再筛除会改变评测集，也受检测错误限制；既有黑盒方法多校准输出或改写提示词，白盒方法则编辑激活或绕过注意力。DeconIEP 改为在输入嵌入上学习逐样本扰动，文本、参数和基准成员关系都不改变。它以污染较轻的检查点作为行为锚点，通过参考引导的 KL 目标学习扰动，而非定位一组固定捷径神经元。新意是为残余污染与干净效用的权衡提供可控的推理时机制，不是证明数据来源或消除训练暴露的方法。有界预算还暴露了可测量的控制变量：更强扰动可降低残余污染，却会提高良性效用损失，因此方法报告的是权衡曲线，而非一个不受限制、自动正确的校正结果。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
DeconIEP is white-box: generating and applying the perturbation requires input embeddings and, during training, gradients. It is therefore not directly usable with closed APIs; test an approximation before treating it as an API-evaluation remedy.

It needs a same-architecture reference that is less contaminated. The paper finds stability up to 30% reference contamination, but warns that heavy contamination, distribution mismatch, or different alignment behavior can degrade results; audit the reference before deployment.

Bounded perturbations show high cosine similarity empirically, not a formal guarantee of preserved semantics or difficulty. It also adds generator and reference overhead, which must be measured for large evaluation runs. The experiments inject benchmark items during fine-tuning, which is a useful controlled condition but may differ from pretraining leakage, repeated web exposure, or unknown data mixtures in deployed models.

DeconIEP 是白盒方法：生成和施加扰动需要输入嵌入，训练时还需要梯度。因此它不能直接用于封闭 API；若想用于 API 评测，必须先验证近似方案。

方法需要同架构且污染较轻的参考模型。论文发现参考污染到 30% 时结果大体稳定，但也警告重度污染、分布不匹配或对齐行为差异都会降低效果；部署前应审计参考模型。

有界扰动在实验中呈现高余弦相似度，却没有对语义或难度保持的形式保证。生成器和参考模型还会带来额外开销，规模化评测前必须测量。实验是在微调阶段注入基准题目，这是一种有用的受控条件，但它可能不同于预训练泄露、网页反复暴露或部署模型中未知的数据混合。结论不能直接外推到这些来源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An evaluator of an open-weight model can start with a base checkpoint, its fine-tuned derivative, and a benchmark where leakage is suspected; train the generator on a disjoint auxiliary subset, then compare residual contamination and clean utility before reporting benchmark scores. Success is a lower residual relative to the matched clean model without a large cross-benchmark utility drop. A benchmark maintainer can use the three leakage constructions to stress-test an intervention instead of merely filtering items. Do not use it when model embeddings/gradients or a plausibly less-contaminated same-architecture reference are unavailable, or when an audit must establish training-data provenance. Keep the original score, corrected score, reference identity, and BUD together in the report; otherwise a lower score cannot be distinguished from indiscriminate capability suppression.

开放权重模型评测者可准备基础检查点、其微调衍生模型和疑似泄露的基准；在不相交辅助子集上训练生成器，再比较残余污染与干净效用后报告分数。成功标准是相对匹配干净模型的残余更低，同时跨基准效用下降不大。基准维护者可用三种泄露构造压力测试干预，而不只是筛掉题目。当无法取得模型嵌入／梯度、缺少可信的同架构低污染参考，或审计必须证明训练数据来源时，不应使用该方法。报告时应同时保留原始分数、校正分数、参考模型身份和 BUD；否则较低分数无法区分究竟是去除了污染虚高，还是不加区分地压制了模型能力。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Separate the paper's three contamination levels: exact, semantic-level, and domain-level leakage.
  2. Read RC as distance from the matched clean model on contaminated data; it is not an estimate of a real model's unknown contamination rate.
  3. Check the cross-benchmark BUD design: MMLU contamination is tested on TruthfulQA and vice versa.
  4. Record the perturbation budget ζ, Daux size 400, occurrence o, reference checkpoint, and whether white-box gradients are available.
  5. Treat the 30% reference-contamination result as an empirical tolerance in this setup, not a general safety threshold or a guarantee for an arbitrary reference. Also verify that Daux is disjoint from the stated test split and that the reported access regime matches the model being audited.

1. 区分论文的三类污染：精确泄露、语义级泄露与领域级泄露。
  2. 将 RC 理解为污染数据上相对匹配干净模型的距离，而不是未知真实模型污染率的估计。
  3. 检查跨基准 BUD 设计：MMLU 污染时在 TruthfulQA 测试，反之亦然。
  4. 记录扰动预算 ζ、Daux 大小 400、出现次数 o、参考检查点，以及是否具备白盒梯度。
  5. 将参考污染 30% 的结果视为该设置中的经验容忍度，不是通用安全阈值，也不是任意参考模型的保证。；还应核对 Daux 是否与所述测试划分不相交，并确认论文报告的访问权限是否与实际被审计模型相匹配，避免把实验白盒条件误写为通用部署方案。
